articles.summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE:EQBK), (“Equity”), the Wichita-based holding company of Equity Bank, will release its second quarter financial results on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, with a press release issued after market close. Equity Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Brad Elliott and Chief Financial Officer Chris Navratil will hold a conference call and webcast to discuss earnings results on Wednesday, July 15, 2026 at 10 a.m. eastern time or 9 a.m. central time.
